methods.name: Card search
methods.description: Returns an up-to-date list of all cards matching the search criteria. For more information about the search parameters, see the Card Search Guide.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The locale to reflect in localized data. If you do not supply a value, all translations are returned.

parameters.name: set
parameters.description: The slug of the set the card belongs to. If you do not supply a value, cards from all sets will be returned.

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: The slug of the card's class.

parameters.name: manaCost
parameters.description: The mana cost required to play the card. You can include multiple values in a comma-separated list of numeric values.

parameters.name: attack
parameters.description: The attack power of the minion or weapon. You can include multiple values in a comma-separated list of numeric values.

parameters.name: health
parameters.description: The health of a minion. You can include multiple values in a comma-separated list of numeric values.

parameters.name: collectible
parameters.description: Whether a card is collectible. A value of 1 indicates that collectible cards should be returned; 0 indicates uncollectible cards. To return all cards, use a value of '0,1'.

parameters.name: rarity
parameters.description: The rarity of a card. This value must match the rarity slugs found in metadata.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of card (for example, minion, spell, and so on). This value must match the type slugs found in metadata.

parameters.name: minionType
parameters.description: The type of minion card (for example, beast, murloc, dragon, and so on). This value must match the minion type slugs found in metadata.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: A required keyword on the card (for example, battlecry, deathrattle, and so on). This value must match the keyword slugs found in metadata.

parameters.name: textFilter
parameters.description: A text string used to filter cards. You must include a locale along with the textFilter parameter.

parameters.name: gameMode
parameters.description: A recognized game mode (for example, battlegrounds or constructed). The default value is constructed. See the Game Modes Guide for more information.

parameters.name: spellSchool
parameters.description: The school of a spell card (for example, arcane, fire, frost, and so on). This value must match the spell school slugs found in metadata.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A page number.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of results to choose per page. A value will be selected automatically if you do not supply a pageSize or if the pageSize is higher than the maximum allowed.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The sort option and direction used to sort the results. Valid values include manaCost:asc, manaCost:desc, attack:asc, attack:desc, health:asc, health:desc, class:asc, class:desc, groupByClass:asc, groupByClass:desc, name:asc, and name:desc. Results are sorted by name:asc by default.

parameters.name: order (deprecated)
parameters.description: The order in which to sort the results if no order is provided with sort option. Valid values are asc or desc. The default value is asc.

methods.name: Battlegrounds card search
methods.description: Returns an up-to-date list of all cards matching the search criteria for the specified game mode. For more information about the search parameters, see the Card Search Guide.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The locale to reflect in localized data. If you do not supply a value, all translations are returned.

parameters.name: gameMode
parameters.description: A recognized game mode (for example, battlegrounds or constructed). The default value is constructed. See the Game Modes Guide for more information.

parameters.name: tier
parameters.description: This special parameter is for tavern tier, which is only recognized when searching for Battlegrounds cards. Valid comma-separated values are numbers 1-6, or the string 'hero'.

parameters.name: attack
parameters.description: The attack power of the minion or weapon. You can include multiple values in a comma-separated list of numeric values.

parameters.name: health
parameters.description: The health of a minion. You can include multiple values in a comma-separated list of numeric values.

parameters.name: minionType
parameters.description: The type of minion card (for example, beast, murloc, dragon, and so on). This value must match the minion type slugs found in metadata.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: A required keyword on the card (for example, battlecry, deathrattle, and so on). This value must match the keyword slugs found in metadata.

parameters.name: textFilter
parameters.description: A text string used to filter cards. You must include a locale along with the textFilter parameter.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A page number.

parameters.name: pageSize

parameters.name: sort

methods.name: Mercenaries card search
methods.description: Returns an up-to-date list of all cards matching the search criteria for the specified game mode. For more information about the search parameters, see the Card Search Guide.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The locale to reflect in localized data. If you do not supply a value, all translations are returned.

parameters.name: gameMode
parameters.description: A recognized game mode (for example, battlegrounds or mercenaries). The default value is constructed. See the Game Modes Guide for more information.

parameters.name: attack
parameters.description: The attack power of the mercenary. You can include multiple values in a comma-separated list of numeric values.

parameters.name: health
parameters.description: The health of a mercenary. You can include multiple values in a comma-separated list of numeric values.

parameters.name: minionType
parameters.description: The type of mercenary card (for example, beast, murloc, dragon, and so on). This value must match the minion type slugs found in metadata.

parameters.name: mercenaryId
parameters.description: The unique numeric ID of a mercenary. This can return multiple cards representing each mercenary skin.

parameters.name: mercenaryRole
parameters.description: The role of a mercenary card (for example, fighter, protector, tank). These values must match the mercenary role slugs in metadata. You can include multiple values in a comma-separated list of values.

parameters.name: defaultMercenary
parameters.description: Whether or not a given card represents the default Mercenary skin. Specify 0 for non-default, and 1 for default.

parameters.name: textFilter
parameters.description: A text string used to filter cards. You must include a locale along with the textFilter parameter.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A page number.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of results to choose per page. A value will be selected automatically if you do not supply a pageSize or if the pageSize is higher than the maximum allowed.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The sort option and direction used to sort the results. Valid values include tier:asc, tier:desc, attack:asc, attack:desc, health:asc, health:desc, name:asc, and name:desc. Results are sorted by name:asc by default.

parameters.name: order (deprecated)
parameters.description: The order in which to sort the results if no order is provided with sort option. Valid values are asc or desc. The default value is asc.

methods.name: Fetch one card
methods.description: Returns the card with an ID or slug that matches the one you specify. For more information, see the Card Search Guide.

parameters.name: :idorslug
parameters.description: An ID or slug that uniquely identifies a card. You can discover these values by using the `GET /hearthstone/cards` endpoint.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The locale to reflect in localized data.

parameters.name: gameMode
parameters.description: A recognized game mode (for example, battlegrounds or constructed). The default value is constructed. See the Game Modes Guide for more information.

methods.name: Card Back Search
methods.description: Returns an up-to-date list of all card backs matching the search criteria. For more information about the search parameters, see the Card Backs Guide.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The locale to reflect in localized data. If you do not supply a value, all translations are returned.

parameters.name: cardBackCategory
parameters.description: A category of the card back. The category must match a valid category.

parameters.name: textFilter
parameters.description: A text string used to filter card backs. You must include a locale along with the textFilter parameter.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field used to sort the results. Valid value include name:asc, name:desc, dateAdded:asc, and dateAdded:desc. Results are sorted by date (desc) by default.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A page number.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of results to choose per page. A value will be selected automatically if you do not supply a pageSize or if the pageSize is higher than the maximum allowed.

parameters.name: order (deprecated)
parameters.description: The order in which to sort the results if no order is provided with sort option. Valid values are asc or desc. The default value is asc.

methods.name: Fetch one card back
methods.description: Returns a specific card back by using card back ID or slug.

parameters.name: :idorslug
parameters.description: An ID or slug that uniquely identifies a card back. You can discover these values by using the GET /hearthstone/cardbacks endpoint

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The locale to reflect in localized data. If you do not supply a value, all translations are returned.

methods.name: Get deck by code
methods.description: Finds a deck by deck code. For more information, see the Retrieving Decks Guide.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The locale to reflect in localized data.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: A code that identifies a deck. You can copy one from the game or various Hearthstone websites. The value should be URL encoded.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: A list of card IDs representing cards in the deck. Ignored if a code parameter is also present.

parameters.name: hero
parameters.description: The card ID for the hero of the deck. Used along with ids. If not present, the API will attempt to add a default hero and class based on the cards in the deck.

methods.name: Get deck by card list
methods.description: Finds a deck by list of cards, including the hero. For more information, see the Retrieving Decks Guide.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The locale to reflect in localized data.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: A code that identifies a deck. You can copy one from the game or various Hearthstone websites. The value should be URL encoded.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: A list of card IDs representing cards in the deck. Ignored if a code parameter is also present.

parameters.name: hero
parameters.description: The card ID for the hero of the deck. Used along with ids. If not present, the API will attempt to add a default hero and class based on the cards in the deck.

methods.name: All metadata
methods.description: Returns information about the categorization of cards. Metadata includes the card set, set group (for example, Standard or Year of the Dragon), rarity, class, card type, minion type, and keywords. For more information, see the Metadata Guide.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The locale to reflect in localized data.

methods.name: Specific metadata
methods.description: Returns information about just one type of metadata. For more information, see the Metadata Guide.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The locale to reflect in localized data.

parameters.name: :type
parameters.description: The type of the metadata to retrieve. Valid values include sets, setGroups, types, rarities, classes, minionTypes, and keywords.
